description: Guilds: contribute. WHEN: move play credits from YOUR wallet into your guild's pooled treasury. Debited through the arena_play_credits ledger; the contribution is a public guild_ledger entry and the treasury balance is derived from that ledger. Members only. Example: guild_contribute {"guild_id":"<guild_id>","amount":"<amount>"}
